definitions.explanation: Training conducted while working at the actual job, learning practical skills through hands-on experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧OJT⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We conduct on-the-job training for new employees.

examples.japanese: OJT⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I learn the job through on-the-job training.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧OJT⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This company has thorough on-the-job training.

notes:
OJT stands for 'On-the-Job Training.' It refers to practical training conducted at the workplace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- OJT⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive on-the-job training
- OJT⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct on-the-job training
- OJT⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: OJT period
- OJT⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: OJT supervisor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- OFF-JT (Off-the-Job Training): training conducted away from the workplace
- {座学|ざがく}: classroom learning
- ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: training (general term)
